title: A Million Indians Went to War Overseas. Not Mostly to France

beats.say: The Government of India counted over a million Indians sent overseas in the First World War.
beats.caption: Govt of India: 1,096,013 sent overseas (to end 1919)

beats.say: But about forty-three percent were not soldiers: they were labourers and followers.
beats.caption: 43.3% non-combatants · 56.7% combatants

beats.say: And most did not go to France. Over sixty percent went to Mesopotamia, now Iraq; thirteen percent, to France.
beats.caption: Mesopotamia 61.6% · France 12.6%

beats.say: More than half the dead, by the Government of India's own table, were in Mesopotamia.
beats.caption: Dead (Govt of India table): Mesopotamia 54.8% · France 14.6%

beats.say: How many Indians died depends on who counted: sixty-one thousand, sixty-two thousand, or about seventy-four thousand.
beats.caption: Govt of India 61,041 · War Office 62,056 · CWGC ≈74,000

beats.say: A million went overseas, and three official counts of the dead still differ.
beats.caption: 1,096,013 went · three counts of the dead
